clear_data.engine: WebView2 ICoreWebView2Profile2::ClearBrowsingData with selected enum flags. Applies to the shared browser profile, so the host should issue one request per profile, not per tab.
clear_data.bounds: 45-second completion watchdog, eight concurrent requests maximum, duplicate-ID detection with correlation tokens. Unknown options/timeRange/non-boolean values reject explicitly before clearing.
clear_data.scope: All-time selected runtime data only. Local ADE history/download JSON, plugin credentials and application permission preferences remain host-owned. No downloaded file is deleted. If the view is destroyed, the runtime may complete or abandon the operation without a callback; the host must close/settle its UI on QObject destruction.
clear_data.verification: Real loopback localStorage clear preserves cookies and Cache Storage; then selected cookies/cacheStorage/HTTP cache clear removes them. Unready, invalid timeRange, duplicate ID and widget deletion in completion tested.

downloads.engine: WebView2 DownloadStarting COM deferral and DownloadOperation bytes/state events; default WebView download dialog suppressed.
downloads.destination: The native host selects an absolute destination. Existing files are rejected unless overwrite=true is explicitly supplied. Directory/symlink destinations, Windows device names, trailing dot/space components and alternate streams reject. Concurrent active downloads cannot share the same normalized destination.
downloads.permission_distinction: A destination choice is requested for each download. The separate downloads permission maps to WebView2 MultipleAutomaticDownloads and is not misrepresented as a blanket permission for first/manual downloads.
downloads.lifecycle: 32 active download limit; destination prompt times out after120seconds by default (configurable50..120000ms). Cancel/timeout/deletion completes pending deferrals and cancels operations. Late decisions are ignored. Paused/resumable interrupted operations retain their native handle; completed/canceled records detach callbacks.
verification: real loopback Content-Disposition filename and total-byte metadata
existing file preserved when overwrite not confirmed
512KiB transfer pause/resume with HTTP Range and exact bytes
delete widget from downloadStarted while accepting COM deferral
downloads.host_responsibilities: Native file chooser/overwrite confirmation, downloads list/history persistence and user-visible progress controls are MainWindow responsibilities. This component never executes downloaded files.

test_evidence.fixture: Only local loopback HTTP and temporary profiles/files. No external website approvals, real device permission acquisition or provider credentials.

remaining_gaps: Time-range clearing and upstream Electron-specific database/favicons/vacuum semantics are not exposed by this BrowserWidget API.
Persistent cross-restart download history and resume are host/product work, not established by an in-memory WebView download handle.
Multiple automatic download permission behavior is mapped, but the tests cover native destination/transfer lifecycle rather than Chromium's heuristic trigger for that permission.
Tests establish these listed Windows/WebView2 behaviors; full upstream browser/device parity is not claimed.
